description.message: A local directory of services you can choose from: email, chat, hosting and more. Kept on this device. No Klin servers.

kis_lead.message: A directory on your own device. You search it, you add to it, you open what you pick. Klin runs no server for it and does not choose for you.

kis_fixed1.message: **Being in the list is not an approval.** The service may have changed, disappeared or be malicious.

kis_fixed2.message: KIS does not certify, guarantee or host anything. Every link takes you to a third party who sees your IP address.

kis_order.message: Alphabetical. Your favourites come first. There are no scores and no ranking.

kis_empty.message: Nothing here yet. Load a catalogue below, or add a service by hand.

kis_err_url.message: The address must start with http:// or https:// and have no user name or password.

kis_err_date.message: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, or leave it empty.

kis_err_dup.message: This address is already in your list.

kis_set_old.message: Call a card old after this many months

kis_c_lead.message: A catalogue is a file of services made by someone else: a community, an association, a person. Nothing is loaded until you ask, and you see every domain before anything is saved.

kis_c_goinfo.message: This contacts that server and it sees your IP address. Klin asks your permission for that one server only, and takes the permission back right after.

kis_c_file.message: Or open a file from this device

kis_c_pub_none.message: Klin offers no public catalogue yet. Before one is offered, its licence is checked. You can paste the address of any catalogue above.

kis_c_prev_profile.message: This is a community profile: a set of services. It cannot change any setting of the browser.

kis_c_prev_sum.message: {1} new, {2} changed, {3} removed, {4} unchanged, {5} skipped because the address is already in your list from somewhere else.

kis_c_restore.message: Go back to the previous version

kis_ce_size.message: The file is bigger than 1 MB. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_json.message: This is not a JSON file. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_format.message: This is not a Klin catalogue (format 1). Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_field.message: The field “{1}” is missing or not valid. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_many.message: There are more than {1} services. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_empty.message: The catalogue has no services. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_service.message: Service number {1} is not valid ({2}). Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_https.message: Only https:// addresses can be downloaded.

kis_ce_net.message: It could not be downloaded: {1}. Nothing was imported.

kis_ce_perm.message: Permission to contact that server was not given. Nothing was downloaded.

kis_cat_cap.message: Cards from a catalogue show where they come from. Turn a catalogue off or remove it and its cards go with it.

kis_not1.message: **It does not rate anyone.** Klin gives no score for independence, trust or ethics. You decide with the filters.

kis_not2.message: ==It is kept on this device only==, in your Klin profile, not encrypted. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing connects by itself.

kis_not3.message: **It does not check the services or the catalogues.** Dates and details are what you or the catalogue wrote. Klin has not verified them.

kis_not4.message: It opens a service in a new tab, the plain way. There is no Klin proxy and no Klin account.
